title: Imantat Iyawsirix
intro: Chʼamanïpkäna uka suma salanakanjja, kawkhantï jan creyiñasa ukat tiranía ukanakas apnaqaskäna, uka cheqanjja, mä sapa cheq aruw jan suytʼat cheqat arsüna. Uka jakhüwix autoridadanakaruw mä yatiyirir arxatañatak ch’axwäna, jupanakan seguridadap jan walt’ayasaw chiqa yatichäwinak yatiyapxäna.
clues: Mä jachʼa tiranía markanwa jakasiyäta, mä apnaqiriruw serviyäta, jupajj diosätwa sasaw säna.
Chiqpach iyawsäwinakaj walja maranakaw imantayäta, ukanak uñachtʼayañax kuna jan walinakansa uñjasispa sasaw axsarayäta.
Kunapachatï mä yatiyirix qhan chimpunak aptʼata jutäna ukhaxa, nayax iyawstwa, ukampis markajax jupa contraw mä amtar puripxäna.
Nayajj tirano ukat conciliopan nayraqatapan saytʼasiyäta, janiw mä jan juchani khitarus jiwayapjjañapäkiti sasaw arsuyäta.
Allah jupax jan wali amtanakapat qhispiyawayitu, ukat nayax uñjtwa t’aqhisiyir apnaqäwin t’unjatätapa.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
